Package fr.univtln.bruno.samples.java101.tp3.map

Class MapExamples

java.lang.Object
fr.univtln.bruno.samples.java101.tp3.map.MapExamples
public class MapExamples extends Object
Examples demonstrating Map implementations and modern Map APIs (compute, merge, etc.). Warning: the modern Map methods heavily use functional interfaces (lambdas) so be sure to read the functional programming lecture before using them.
